item.title: Rupee rises 6 paise to 90.89 against US dollar in early trade
item.description: MUMBAI: The rupee gained 6 paise to 90.89 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday aided by a weaker greenback and a strong opening in the domestic equity markets. However, a sharp rise in global crude oil prices and FII outflows prevented sharp gains in the local unit, forex traders said. At the [...]

item.title: Anti-Corruption Bureau Searches Residence of Deputy CM Surinder Choudhary’s Brother in Jammu
item.description: JAMMU: The Jammu and Kashmir Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) on Wednesday carried out a raid at the residence of Vijay Choudhary, brother of the Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary, in connection with a disproportionate assets case, sources said. item.title: UN: India abstains on draft resolution calling for unconditional ceasefire between Russia, Ukraine
item.description: India abstained in the UN General Assembly on a draft resolution that called for an immediate, full and unconditional ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. The draft resolution, ‘Support for lasting peace in Ukraine,’ coming on the fourth anniversary of the Russian invasion of its neighbour, was adopted by the 193-member UN General Assembly, with 107 [...]

item.title: Sikkim: Over 2,700 tourists rescued after heavy snowfall blocks road to Tsomgo Lake
item.description: GANGTOK: Over 2,700 tourists stranded due to heavy snowfall near Tsomgo Lake in East Sikkim were rescued, officials said on Wednesday morning. Heavy snowfall in the higher reaches of Sherathang and adjoining areas led to road blockages, leaving 541 tourist vehicles stranded between 15th Mile and Tsomgo Lake, they said.
